prompt:
Create a new 16:9 storyboard keyframe for a music video. Image 1 is the style reference: match its 1990s hand-painted cel anime look, ink line quality, film grain and VHS softness exactly. Image 2 is FAST's model sheet: draw FAST exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Image 3 is SLOW's model sheet: draw SLOW exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). FAST's world: bright, saturated 90s colors (traffic-cone orange, teal, purple; neon if it is night), energetic diagonal composition, speed lines only where something moves fast.
Scene: Inside the bodega: a wall calendar reads 'SEPTEMBER 1991'; FAST confidently scrawls a big '2029' over it with a marker. SLOW behind the counter pinches the bridge of his nose.
Camera: Medium, calendar foreground.
Characters: FAST and SLOW only, no one else unless the scene mentions extras. Their mouths are closed or relaxed (nobody is mid-word).
The only readable text in the image: 'SEPTEMBER 1991'; '2029', spelled exactly and rendered as part of the scene on real objects. No other text, captions, subtitles or speech bubbles.
No borders, no panel frames, not a comic page.
